clue.text: To prepare explorer, first: steam clean, fold; second: iron

indicators.note: first: points to the opening letter of the word steam that follows it

parts.note: to clean something is to wash it
to fold or crumple under pressure is to buckle

indicators.note: second: points to the second letter of the word iron that follows it

explanation.surface: Laundry instructions for getting an explorer ready: steam, wash and fold, then press.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads like a laundry routine, but 'first:' takes S from 'steam' and 'second:' takes R, the second letter of 'iron'.
explanation.definitionFit: A swashbuckling adventurer is a daring seeker of excitement, loosely an explorer of risky exploits.

clue.text: Switch around alternatives to prayer

indicators.note: around says the word for switch encloses the other piece

parts.note: a switch is a thin whip or cane
alternatives are ors, as in 'this or that'

explanation.surface: A suggestion to swap other options in for prayer.
explanation.definitionFit: Prayer and devotional adoration are both acts of religious reverence.

clue.text: One who waits beneath southern night sky, perhaps?

indicators.note: in a down answer, beneath puts the waiter's word below the abbreviation for southern

parts.note: one who tarries, or lingers, is a tarrier

explanation.surface: Someone lingers under the Southern Hemisphere's night sky.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is comparative: a night sky is perhaps more star-filled than the daytime one.
explanation.definitionFit: A night sky, with stars showing, is more full of stars than a daytime one, so it is an example of something more starry.

clue.text: Nail support down

parts.note: a bra is a supporting undergarment

explanation.surface: A fingernail gives some support while pointing downward.
explanation.definitionFit: A brad is a thin small-headed wire nail.

clue.text: Confiscate drug-seizure by captain

indicators.note: seizure by says the drug letter is grabbed and held inside the captain

parts.note: a naval captain may be a commander
E is the crossword shorthand for ecstasy, a drug

explanation.surface: A ship's captain impounds narcotics in a drug seizure.
explanation.definitionFit: To take possession of goods officially is to seize or confiscate them.

clue.text: 50A light fittings

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty
A is the symbol for amperes, read here as amps

explanation.surface: A rating of fifty amps for some light fixtures.
explanation.walkthrough: '50A' looks like a cross-reference to another clue, but it is fifty (L) followed by A, the symbol for amps.
explanation.definitionFit: Lighting fixtures that hold bulbs are lamps.

clue.text: Held up by whacko, man urged to go on killing spree

indicators.note: Held up says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A crazed man, egged on, goes off on a murderous rampage.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down answer 'Held up' signals reading upward; 'by' links the indicator to the words holding the letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To run amok is to rush about in a violent frenzy, attacking people.

clue.text: Chair backs protection for arbitrator in mass train dispute

indicators.note: in places the arbitrator's abbreviation inside the rearranged letters
dispute suggests the letters of mass train are at odds and rearranged

parts.note: ACAS is the UK Advisory, Conciliation and Arbitration Service, which settles industrial disputes

explanation.surface: Back cushions for a mediator at a big rail strike.
explanation.walkthrough: ACAS is the British government body that mediates in strikes, such as a rail dispute.
explanation.definitionFit: These are cloths laid over chair backs to protect upholstery from hair oil.

clue.text: Focus on making a stronger solution

definitions.meaning: chemically, increasing the proportion of dissolved substance in a liquid

explanation.definitionFit: Mental focus is one sense; the chemical process of strengthening a solution is the other.

clue.text: Grandma clasps one bible in religious ecstasy

indicators.note: clasps says grandma's word holds the other pieces inside it

parts.note: nana is an informal word for grandmother
I is the Roman numeral for one
RV is the Revised Version of the Bible

explanation.surface: Granny hugs her Bible in a state of spiritual rapture.
explanation.definitionFit: In Buddhism this is the state of blissful enlightenment, so a kind of religious transcendence.

clue.text: Persistent idea not unexpectedly might be kept for sentimental reasons

definitions.text: might be kept for sentimental reasons

parts.note: a meme is an idea or image that spreads and persists in a culture

indicators.note: unexpectedly says the letters of not turn up in surprising order

explanation.surface: An idea that keeps coming back may be kept for sentimental reasons.
explanation.definitionFit: A keepsake treasured for its memories is a souvenir.

clue.text: Discharge singers when one is early

indicators.note: is early says the one-letter piece moves forward to an earlier place in the word

parts.note: a choir is a group of singers
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Choristers are released when one of them turns up early.
explanation.walkthrough: Moving I from near the end of CHOIR to the front gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Medically, this is a thin watery fluid oozing from a wound or ulcer.

clue.text: Extract bone before cooking basic malt vinegar

indicators.note: cooking says the remaining letters are stirred into a new order
Extract says a letter is pulled out of the fodder before it is rearranged

parts.note: bone gives T, as in the T-shaped bone of a T-bone steak

explanation.surface: A recipe step: remove the bone, then cook with plain malt vinegar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Extract' takes T out of BASIC MALT, leaving BASICMAL; 'cooking' rearranges those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Balsamic is a dark, sweet Italian vinegar from Modena.

clue.text: Woman's arrested priest, Christian, as agent of revolutionary uprising

indicators.note: arrested says the woman's word holds the others captive inside

parts.note: her is the possessive for a woman
Eli is the priest in the biblical Books of Samuel
a Copt is an Egyptian Christian

explanation.surface: A woman has detained a priest and a Christian as agents of a revolt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Revolutionary uprising' is not politics: rotors revolve and the machine rises vertically.
explanation.definitionFit: A rotorcraft lifts off by spinning blades, so it rises by revolving.

clue.text: Twigs on collars

definitions.meaning: to twig is informal British for to understand or grasp
to collar a suspect is to arrest them

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both grasps mentally and arrests, matching twigs and collars.

clue.text: Like pretending wings fall off

indicators.note: wings fall off says the outermost letters on each side are lost

parts.note: faking is pretending

explanation.surface: It is like pretending the wings dropped off.
explanation.walkthrough: The wings are the first and last letters of FAKING, F and G.
explanation.definitionFit: Two things that are similar or related are alike.

clue.text: Tote included, wagers outside Britain are unlikely to be repaid

indicators.note: wagers outside Britain means the bets wrap around the letter for Britain
included says the tote word goes inside the wagers

parts.note: wagers are bets
to tote up is to add

explanation.surface: The tote's takings and foreign bets are seldom paid back.
explanation.walkthrough: Two containers nest: 'included' puts the tote word inside the wagers, then 'outside' wraps them round Britain's letter. The definition is adjectival; 'are' links it to the plural-noun answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Loans written off as irrecoverable are debts lenders cannot expect to see returned.

clue.text: Mocking article leads in the wrong direction

indicators.note: leads says the article comes in front of the other piece

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
wry humour is dry and mocking

explanation.surface: A sarcastic newspaper piece steers its readers astray.
explanation.definitionFit: Something askew has gone off course, away from the intended line.

clue.text: Possibly sweet murmurings in the theatre

definitions.meaning: a sweet is a British dessert, and stewed sticks of this plant often make one
actors murmur this word repeatedly to suggest background crowd chatter

explanation.definitionFit: The plant's stalks make puddings, and the word is the stage crowd's chatter.

clue.text: It bugs father when reversing to have broken windscreen attachment

indicators.note: to have broken says the reversed piece breaks into the windscreen attachment

parts.note: a wiper is fitted to a car windscreen

indicators.note: reversing says the word for father is read backwards

parts.note: pater is Latin, and old British slang, for father

explanation.surface: Dad gets annoyed when he backs up and breaks the windscreen wiper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reversing' reads the Latin word for father backwards, giving RETAP; 'to have broken' puts that inside the windscreen attachment. 'It bugs' reads as annoyance but means planting listening devices.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who plants listening devices on phone lines eavesdrops, so this person bugs.

clue.text: Plain portal is raised unevenly

indicators.note: unevenly says take the odd-numbered letters, first, third, fifth and so on

explanation.surface: A simple doorway has been built up at an uneven angle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plain' looks like an adjective describing the portal, but it is a noun: flat grassland.
explanation.definitionFit: A plain is a broad, flat grassland, as on the North American prairies.

clue.text: Doctor has little time to fish

indicators.note: has says the doctor's word holds the time letter inside

parts.note: a surgeon is a doctor
T is the short form of time

explanation.surface: A doctor has very little time to go fishing.
explanation.definitionFit: This large fish is the source of caviar.

clue.text: Developed wrong design

indicators.note: design says the letters of wrong are rearranged into a new pattern

explanation.surface: A badly planned layout was produced.
explanation.definitionFit: A matured person or thing has developed fully.

clue.text: Queen captured in silly plan

indicators.note: captured in says the queen's letter is held inside the silly word

parts.note: daft means silly
R is short for Regina, Latin for queen

explanation.surface: The queen was taken prisoner in a foolish scheme.
explanation.definitionFit: A preliminary version of a scheme is a rough outline.

clue.text: The French take directions here

parts.note: le is French for the
N and S are the compass directions north and south

explanation.surface: French people get their bearings at this spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'here' refers to the clue's French setting: Lens is a town in northern France.
explanation.definitionFit: Lens is a town in northern France, the place the clue's French people are.

clue.text: Announce the results

definitions.meaning: to announce is to ... aloud to listeners, in verb form split as two words
a display of data from an instrument or computer

explanation.definitionFit: As two words, to proclaim; as one hyphenated noun, an instrument's displayed data.

clue.text: Measure to prohibit move?

parts.note: an em is a printer's measure of type width
to bar is to prohibit
to go is to move

explanation.surface: A rule banning movement.
explanation.definitionFit: An official ban on trade or shipping with a country is an order stopping movement of goods.

clue.text: What computers use to calculate where two stars are

definitions.meaning: computers do arithmetic in base two, with zeros and ones
in astronomy, a pair of stars orbiting each other

explanation.definitionFit: Base-two arithmetic is one sense; a pair of stars orbiting a common centre is the other.
